### Physician and clinical pharmacologist in training

I am a specialty registrar in clinical pharmacology at [Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg Hospital](https://www.bispebjerghospital.dk/), Copenhagen, with a PhD in medical science. I study whether pharmacogenetic testing and therapeutic drug monitoring change prescribing and patient outcomes. The data come from Danish nationwide health registers, the Copenhagen Hospital Biobank and prospective clinical trials.

Right now I run [SAMSON-2](projects/samson2.qmd), a nationwide N-of-1 trial on statin intolerance, and [TDM-VISION](projects/tdm-vision.qmd), a drug monitoring project for ibrutinib and venetoclax in chronic lymphocytic leukemia. In parallel I link CYP2C19 and SLCO1B1 genotypes from the [Copenhagen Hospital Biobank](projects/chb-pharmacogenetics.qmd) to clinical outcomes in nationwide registers.

See all [projects](projects.qmd), the [publication list](publications.qmd) or the [CV as PDF](cv-michael-andersen.pdf).
